full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a dark-haired man close to the camera on the right, with a bleak shoreline fading behind him on the left. The background begins with a broad pale overcast sky and a quiet strip of water along the far left. A low, uneven shore runs diagonally back from the lower foreground toward a small dark structure near the center horizon. The ground is rough and softly blurred, with scattered pale patches but no distinct objects demanding attention. In the right half, the man's head and upper body nearly touch the top and side borders. Short dark hair falls in irregular strands over his forehead, and one ear is cut near the frame edge. His face turns slightly toward the viewer while his gaze rests directly on the camera, giving the expression a tired, guarded stillness. The nose, cheek, and lips are shaped by mid-gray light; the eye sockets and the side of the nose descend into darker tones. A high dark coat collar rises around the neck and continues as a broad nearly black shape into the lower right corner. The large empty sky beside him gives the close face room to breathe, while the distant shoreline adds an austere sense of place. Flat outdoor daylight comes from the open sky, gently illuminating the near cheek and forehead without a hard cast shadow. Fine film grain and shallow focus hold the face's small irregularities while reducing the shore and far structure to simple tonal masses. The photograph avoids decorative color and relies on black, silver gray, and off-white values. There is no readable text. The overall composition is asymmetric and intimate, setting an intense close presence against a soft, lonely distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片呈现一名黑发男子在右侧靠近镜头，荒凉海岸在他身后向左方淡去。背景始于宽阔的浅色阴天天空和最左边安静的一条水面。低而不平的岸线从前景下方斜向后退，通向地平线中央附近一座小小的暗色结构。地面粗糙且柔化，散布浅色斑块，却没有抢眼的明确物件。右半部，男子的头和上身几乎碰到上方与侧边画框。深色短发以不规则发丝落在额头，一只耳朵在边缘附近被裁切。他的脸略向观者转来，目光直接落在镜头上，表情疲惫、戒备而静止。鼻子、脸颊和嘴唇由中灰色光塑造；眼窝和鼻侧转入更深的明度。深色高衣领围住颈部，并作为近黑的大形延伸至右下角。身旁大片空白天空让贴近的脸有呼吸空间，远处岸线则带来简朴的地点感。平坦的户外天光来自开阔天空，轻轻照亮近侧脸颊和额头，没有硬投影。细微胶片颗粒和浅景深保留脸上的细小不规则，同时把海岸与远处结构收缩为简单的明暗团块。照片不靠装饰色彩，而依赖黑、银灰和灰白的明度。画面没有可读文字。整体构图不对称且亲密，以强烈的近处存在对照柔和而孤独的远方。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photographic style pairs a close, sharply observed focal form with a distant setting reduced by shallow depth of field. Broad off-white and middle-gray areas provide quiet negative space, while a nearly black mass anchors one side of the frame. Soft overcast light models surfaces through gradual transitions, allowing natural texture and small irregularities to remain visible without theatrical highlights. Fine film grain and slightly softened far edges give the image the feel of an unpolished print. A diagonal recession into the background counters the weight of the cropped near form and keeps the asymmetric composition stable. Tonal contrast is strongest around the focal area and loosens across the open field. The overall effect is candid, austere, and introspective, with emotional weight carried by proximity and emptiness.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白摄影风格把贴近、观察细致的焦点形体与被浅景深压缩的远处环境配在一起。宽阔的灰白及中灰区域提供安静留白，一块近黑体量锚住画面一侧。柔和阴天光以渐进过渡塑造表面，使自然肌理和细小不规则保持可见，却没有戏剧性高光。细微胶片颗粒与略被柔化的远方边缘让图像带有未经修饰的冲印感。斜向后退的纵深抵消近处裁切形体的重量，使不对称构图保持稳定。明暗对照在焦点周围最强，越过开阔区域后逐渐松开。整体效果抓拍、简朴而内省，情感重量由逼近的距离和空寂承载。
theme_en: A dark-haired man at a bleak shoreline
theme_zh: 荒凉海岸旁的黑发男子
name: Derek Jarman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
